add.keys: Enter adds and keeps the form open, Ctrl+Enter adds and closes.
add.lose: Are you sure? The elements added here will not be saved.
anti.enable: This element is anti-value, but the outgoing value axis has no negative part. Switch the anti-value part on?
axis.autoOff: Autoscale is off for this axis.
board.title: Board title
card.label: Selected element
clear.ask: Are you sure you want to delete all elements?
col.title: Element
err.divisions: Too many divisions: (max - min) / step must not exceed 200.
err.dupCode: {type} with the code {code} is already in the list
err.in: incoming value is not a number
err.out: outgoing value is not a number
err.scale: Check the scale: max must be greater than min, within ±1 000 000 000.
err.title: no title
exp.csv: List of elements, for Google Sheets and trackers
exp.later: XLSX and PNG export come in the next update.
exp.onlyShown: Only the elements shown now (filters and search)
exp.withGoals: Include goals and references in the configuration
field.title: Title
flow.done: Everything on this axis is estimated.
flow.question: Where does it go on "{axis}"?

imp.board.one: A whole board with {n} element. It replaces the current board (Undo brings it back).
imp.board.other: A whole board with {n} elements. It replaces the current board (Undo brings it back).

imp.config: A board configuration (axes, buckets, types, priority).

imp.dups.one: {n} element is already on the board (same external ID or code).
imp.dups.other: {n} elements are already on the board (same external ID or code).

imp.errors.one: {n} line has errors and will be skipped: {lines}
imp.errors.other: {n} lines have errors and will be skipped: {lines}

imp.hint: A board (.vet.json), a configuration (.vet-config.json), a list (.vet-items.json) or a table (CSV or TSV with a header row; estimates may be empty). The file never leaves your browser.
imp.invalid: This file is not a VET document.
imp.newer: The file was made by a newer version of VET.
imp.newFromConfig: Create a new board from it
imp.noColumns: No title or code column found in the first row.
imp.tooBig: The file is larger than 10 MB.
imp.tooMany: More than 5000 elements in one file.
list.empty: No elements yet. Add them one by one or paste a list.
list.label: Elements sorted by priority
notice.solo: Data is not saved: it lives only in this tab. Export the board to keep it.
paste.format: One line = one element. Columns separated by Tab or ";": code; title; outgoing; incoming. A line with only text becomes a title. Paste straight from Excel or Google Sheets.
paste.hint: DEMO-1; Onboarding of a new user; 17; 6
preset.suggestDiff: Both axes are in the same units. Switch priority to the difference (out - in)?
scales.label: Scales
set.anti: Account for anti-value (negative part of the scale)
set.bucketsOnly: Buckets only: hide numbers; an element dropped into a bucket gets its middle value

set.outside.one: {n} estimate falls outside the new scale. It will be kept and shown at the edge. Rescale it proportionally instead?
set.outside.other: {n} estimates fall outside the new scale. They will be kept and shown at the edge. Rescale them proportionally instead?

set.priority.differenceHint: When both axes are in the same units (money and money).
set.priority.outHint: Only the value is estimated; the incoming axis is hidden.
set.priority.ratioHint: Default. When the axes are in different units (money and effort).
set.teamSoon: Team mode with links by role, blind estimation and the VSS and Ledger integrations come in the next stages. Today VET works in your browser only.
share.soon: Team mode is in development. For now export the board and send the file.

type.deleteAsk.one: This type has {n} element. Move it to another type or delete it with the type?
type.deleteAsk.other: This type has {n} elements. Move them to another type or delete them with the type?

view.label: View
warn.negIn: Incoming value is negative: the ratio makes no sense, the difference out - in is shown. Consider switching priority to the difference.

team.modeHint.open: Everybody sees all markers as they move.
team.modeHint.blind: Each person sees only their own estimates until you press "Reveal". Protects from anchoring.
team.modeHint.shared: One set of markers that everybody with the "Estimate" role can move, like a wall with sticky notes.
team.status.offline: No connection, changes will be sent later
team.status.conflict: Someone changed the same thing, the board was reloaded
team.discussHint: The estimates fall into different buckets: worth a discussion.
team.notAllowed: Your role does not allow this change.
team.closedHint: The session is closed: the board is read only, export still works.
team.exportFirst: This browser blocks storage. Export the board first, then sign in.
team.conflict: Someone else changed the same setting or element. You see their version now.
team.lost: Your access to this board ended.
team.signIn: This team board needs you to sign in or to join by a link.
team.notFound: This board does not exist or was deleted.
team.forbidden: You have no access to this board. Ask the facilitator for a link.
share.linksHint: Send a link with the role people need. A new link replaces the old one with the same role.
share.renewHint: Issue a new link; the old one stops working
share.renewed: New link ready, the old one stopped working
share.guests: Guests can join with a name, without an account
share.closeAsk: Close the session? The board becomes read only for everybody; export still works.
share.restoreAsk: Restore this version? The current state is saved as a version first.
set.teamOn: This is a team board: estimates are saved on the institute server. Links, estimation mode and the session are in "Share".
set.teamOff: Now the board lives only in this tab. "Share with a team" saves it in your ÆVRI account and gives links by role: edit, estimate, view.
bridge.sessionGone: This VET session has expired or was already used. Go back to the schema and open VET again.
bridge.saveLedger: Save and return to the wallet
